description: Identifies Service Portal widgets with KB-related names where the public field is set to true, allowing unauthenticated access. AppOmni research showed that attackers can access misconfigured KBs through public widgets, including brute-forcing incremental KB article numbers (KB0000001, KB0000002, etc.) using the widget server-side API without authentication.
name: cstaces-11o public-kb-widget
resolution_details: Navigate to sp_widget.list and set the public field to false on any KB-related widgets. If public access is intentionally required for specific widgets, ensure that all referenced knowledge bases have proper user criteria and that the widget code enforces access checks.
